backend/main.mo: Motoko backend managing user profiles with access control plus lead capture CRUD restricted to admins except public lead submission.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to affected files, components, and test IDs with high‑confidence metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: List of summarized descriptions for major frontend files including layout, sections, config, and data modules.
frontend/deploy.config.json: JSON config enforcing production slug pkcurbancapital with notes for correct live deployment behavior.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide outlining required production slug pkcurbancapital and steps for preparing and publishing the build.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining OKLCH color tokens and light/dark theme variables for the site.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML file loading fonts and mounting the React application via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component composing all site sections with scroll refs, theme provider, and floating action buttons.
frontend/src/components/admin/Commercial: Admin panel enabling create, update, and delete operations for commercial projects with dialog-based form handling.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button handling Internet Identity auth with status display and retry logic.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal for entering and saving a user's display name after authentication.
frontend/src/components/commercial/Comme: Displays commercial project details with highlights and a WhatsApp contact button.
frontend/src/components/FloatingCallButt: Floating button opening the configured tel: link using CONTACT_CONFIG.
frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsApp: Floating button generating a clean WhatsApp link and opening it in a new tab.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteFoote: Footer showing brand info, service areas, property types, and contact details.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteHeade: Header with branding, login button, call link, and consultation CTA.
frontend/src/components/properties/Prope: Card showing property details, ROI badge, and a WhatsApp CTA for pricing inquiries.
frontend/src/components/sections/AboutSe: About section listing reasons to choose the service using COPY content items.
frontend/src/components/sections/Feature: Section fetching and displaying commercial projects with admin panel and profile setup logic.
frontend/src/components/sections/HeroSec: Renders the hero section with background visuals, headline, description, and CTA buttons wired to callback props.
frontend/src/components/sections/Investo: Provides a simple investment calculator that computes annual ROI based on user‑entered property price and rent.
frontend/src/components/sections/LeadCap: Implements a lead capture form with validation, backend submission, and a success state UI.
frontend/src/components/sections/OurAppr: Displays a static section explaining the company’s approach using COPY content.
frontend/src/components/sections/PuneWes: Shows a styled section detailing Pune West’s long‑term growth drivers, considerations, and market outlook.
frontend/src/components/sections/Testimo: Renders investor testimonials with ratings and quotes sourced from a testimonials dataset.
frontend/src/components/sections/WhyInve: Displays reasons to invest in Pune with icons and descriptions from a predefined list.
frontend/src/config/contact.ts: Defines central contact details including phone formats, email, and location.
frontend/src/config/whatsapp.ts: Provides WhatsApp config and helper functions to generate message links, including property‑specific messages.
frontend/src/content/copy.ts: Contains all UI copy strings for hero, forms, admin panel, and property sections.
frontend/src/data/properties.ts: Deprecated static property types and empty list kept only for reference.
frontend/src/data/testimonials.ts: Defines testimonial type and a static list of customer testimonials.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor, refreshing it on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminStatus.ts: Checks if the current caller is an admin using the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useCommercialProjects: CRUD hooks for commercial projects using the backend actor and react-query.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, managing login, logout, and stored identities.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides a mutation hook for submitting lead capture forms.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserProfile.ts: Hooks to fetch and save the logged‑in user's profile via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and custom color variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point initializing React, QueryClient, and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters, store/retrieve them in sessionStorage, and optionally persist or clear them for hash-based routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS with custom colors, typography, animations, and plugins for the frontend build.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s state, including deployment goals, features, and pending requests related to updating the live web app.
